claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Holy Avenger has a passive weapon rider that adds extra damage only when this weapon hits a Fiend or an Undead. The current magic-item families cover passive grants, activations, triggered reactions, and spawned creatures, but not persistent on-hit riders.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_aura_component_for_magic_items
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item continuously projects an emanation from the bearer that affects other creatures in an area. Current non-spell passive mechanics have no attachment-bearing aura form; area attachments only exist on spell families.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.sourceFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura grants advantage only on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, not on all saving throws.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects

claude_proposed_widenings.name: area_shape_scaling_by_named_class_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The emanation's radius changes from 10 feet to 30 feet at Paladin level 17. The current surface does not let a non-spell area attachment scale by a named class-level threshold.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.
